snippet.title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie Video Game - F3 2025 Trailer
snippet.description:
An all new trailer for F3 2025! Thank you Kaze for having me for another year!

Experience and play through the Super Mario Bros Movie in an all new epic way through an action packed 2D Platformer along with a rewritten and revised story! Releasing on the 19th of September for SAGE 2025!

Download the demo today!
https://speedymcfly.itch.io/thesupermariobrosmovievideogame

Vote for the F3 winner here!
https://strawpoll.com/ajnE1V62NnW

Join the discord!
https://discord.gg/5rdyuEcG37

Mario's 40th Anniversary Logo by Olitheguy64
